title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
abstract: arXiv:2608.15767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. translated_title: TinyCast：基于计算周期性的概率零样本预测
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了TinyCast，一个无需注意力机制的零样本预测器，它仅用146,505个参数即可输出预测分布，其前提是在如此小的规模下，上下文的周期性结构值得计算而非学习。一个零参数频谱检测器提供主导周期，上下文按其相位折叠，然后由膨胀卷积编码器和块自回归分位数解码器处理其余部分。它比GIFT-Eval排行榜上所有参数数量可确定的零样本条目都更小。在概率准确性上，它定义了大小-准确性前沿。在声明无测试数据泄露的零样本条目中，它是唯一一个参数低于140万且能输出预测分布的模型，而每个得分更高的条目至少拥有该预算。在Chronos-ZS和fev-bench上，每个领先于它的神经模型至少拥有其28倍的参数。由于混合路径是卷积和矩阵运算。
tldr: TinyCast是一个仅有14.6万参数的零样本概率预测模型，通过计算周期性而非学习，以极小规模实现了与更大模型相当或更优的预测性能，定义了大小-准确性前沿。
en_tdlr: TinyCast is a 146K-parameter zero-shot probabilistic forecaster that computes periodicity instead of learning it, achieving competitive or superior accuracy at a fraction of the size, defining the size-accuracy frontier.
